name: Albert Memory
description: Bounded cited recall and minimized lifecycle capture for OpenClaw.

transport.description: native: recall and capture from inside the gateway process; adapter: spawn albert-openclaw-adapter per hook (legacy).

credentialsFile.description: Owner-only credential file written by albert-capture install (native transport).

recallTimeoutMs.description: Bound on the single recall call made before each prompt (native transport).

recallMaxItems.description: Most memories injected per prompt (native transport).

recallMaxCharacters.description: Size bound of the injected recall block (native transport).

captureTimeoutMs.description: Bound on each capture write; slower writes go to the encrypted queue (native transport).

outageCooldownMs.description: After two consecutive recall failures, skip recall for this long (native transport).
